LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL MARCH 14, 2006
AGENDA PAGE 6
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
March 14, 2006
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on March 14, 2006, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF A PROCLAMATION IN HONOR OF "AMERICAN RED CROSS MONTH"
PRESENTATION OF THE AMERICAN FLAG TO THE MOTHER OF RONNIE CORNIEL
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION TO ROWLAND UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT IN HONOR OF THE 150TH ANNIVERSARY OF ADULT EDUCATION IN THE UNITED STATES
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 28, 2006
Minutes of February 28, 2006
Solis moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of February 28, 2006. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
C-1
ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 2, CHAPTER 2.04 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO CITY COUNCIL MEETING CONDUCT AND PROCEDURES (Introduced by title only and further reading waived at meeting of February 28, 2006)
Ordinance Rept
Ordinance Amending Title 2
Perez moved to adopt the ordinance as presented. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF ADDITIONAL SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS
Additional Scholarship Awards
Lujan moved to approve $18,000 to award 36 scholarships for the next fiscal year. ; seconded by Perez.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: Solis.
C-3
BUDGET RESOLUTION FOR REMAINING BALANCE OWED TO BELFOR, USA CONSTRUCTION, INC. FOR REHABILITATION WORK AT THE COMMUNITY CENTER
Belfor Budget Approp Rept
Belfor Budget Reso
Perez moved to approve the budget resolution in the amount of $71,947.36 for Belfor, USA Construction, Inc. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken :
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Lujan moved to approve Items D-1 through D-8 on the Consent Calendar; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
D-1.
RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1174 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2005-06
Warrant Register No. 1174

CDBG Housing Monthly Rept

Acceptance of Elevator Project
Notice of Completion

ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING THE CONTINUED NEED TO MAKE EMERGENCY REPAIRS OF AN IMMINENT HAZARD ON THE HILLSIDE BEHIND 133 AND 139 ROUNDABOUT DRIVE AND 140 AND 148 HILLCREST DRIVE
Roundabout Emergency Rept
Roundabout Emergency Reso
Attachment B

Parcel Map No. 61552 Rept

CONSIDERATION OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM (D97301-06)- FISCAL YEAR 2005-06

NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A PROPOSAL FROM THE BASSETT UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT REQUESTING ASSISTANCE AND APPROVAL OF THEIR "I LOVE BASSETT" DAY PARADE
I Love Bassett Day Rept
Perez moved to approve the five requests made by Bassett Unified School District for the City's assistance with the I Love Bassett Day parade.; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF THE USE OF SECURITY SHUTTERS AND SCREENS IN COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL ZONES (Requested by Council Member Solis)
Security Shutters Rept
Solis moved to direct Staff to bring an ordinance to Council for reconsideration. ; seconded by Storing.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT WITH FIRST NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY OF AMERICA REGARDING THE YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER

Lujan moved to approve the Agreement with First National Insurance Company of America and authorize the Mayor to sign the Agreement.; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
